# opnsense_kea_ddns_settings (Resource)

Kea DHCP-DDNS settings (**Services ▸ Kea DHCP ▸ DDNS**). Zones, DNS servers and TSIG keys are set per subnet on `opnsense_kea_dhcpv4_subnet`. This is a singleton: import it with the ID `kea_ddns_settings` before managing it. Attributes left unset keep their current value.

## Example Usage

```terraform
import {
  to = opnsense_kea_ddns_settings.this
  id = "kea_ddns_settings"
}

resource "opnsense_kea_ddns_settings" "this" {
  enabled = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable the Kea DHCP-DDNS service, which sends DNS updates for the subnets that have `ddns_forward_zone` set.
- `manual_config` (Boolean) Use a hand-written kea-dhcp-ddns.conf instead of the generated one.
- `server_ip` (String) IPv4 address the DDNS service listens on for requests from the DHCP servers.
- `server_port` (Number) Port the DDNS service listens on. `-1` when unset; set `-1` to clear it.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `kea_ddns_settings`.
